Dear Ms Lombardi, Mr Savary, and Mr Rullon,

I am applying for the Communication & Design Internship with SEA Naval at SEA Europe. My background sits at the intersection of digital communication, web production, and content: I currently work freelance and with Episto on SEO, WordPress content, and AI-assisted workflows, and I have built sites from structure to launch using Elementor, Canva, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

The internship's focus on EU-funded projects, brand identity, and multimedia communication matches how I like to work: practical design, clear content, and measurable reach. I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, and live in Belgium, close to Brussels. I am available for a full-time six-month internship and can start in mid-October. I would be glad to support SEA Naval's project communication and learn the naval and defence context directly.

My CV, cover letter, and portfolio (baverok.com) are attached. Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Ms Lombardi, Mr Savary, and Mr Rullon,

I am writing to apply for the Communication & Design Internship with SEA Naval at SEA Europe. I am a digital marketer with a technical background, based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I work where web production, content, and search meet. In practice, that means I build and maintain websites, write content that is meant to be found and understood, and use design and AI tools to make communication work flow better.

Most of my recent work has been hands-on and varied. At Episto and through my own freelance practice, I manage SEO content, publish and update pages in WordPress with Elementor, Astra, and Rank Math, and keep sites consistent as they grow. I designed and built baverok.com myself, including a hand-coded landing page, structured data, and an enquiry flow. For mirook.com, I implemented schema markup and an llms.txt file and ran technical audits that improved the site's search health. I have also supported Shopify stores, created content for client blogs, and worked on SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo at Knowledge Experts.

Your internship stands out because it asks for someone who can move between social media, brand identity, multimedia content, and event communication for EU-funded naval and defence projects. My toolkit includes Canva, WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AI-assisted workflows. I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, and improving my Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking). I am eager to learn the naval and defence side of the work and to contribute reliably to SEA Naval's project visibility and stakeholder engagement.

My CV, cover letter, and portfolio are attached. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my digital communication and web skills could support your team.

Yours sincerely,
Baver Ok
